aiReview.overallSummary: The TrialIQ application demonstrates high quality landing, authentication, settings, clinical workspace, and clinical intelligence screens, with clear visual hierarchy, evidence grounding, and decision-readiness callouts. However, several dashboard sub-routes (Dashboard main, Review Queue, Analytics, Reports) show generic loading text states rather than rich empty states or skeleton layouts.

strengths: Clear visual hierarchy with prominent 'Launch Workspace' CTAs in header, hero, and footer
Comprehensive core module showcase explaining protocol, participant, safety, and coding features
Clean typography, dark/light contrast balance, and trustworthy branding
reviews.reviewNotes: The landing page effectively presents the product value proposition and provides multiple distinct entry points into the workspace.

strengths: Symmetrical split layout separating benefit propositions from the sign-in form
Clear labels, icon-adorned input fields, and distinct primary action button
reviews.reviewNotes: Authentication layout is intuitive, clean, and modern.

strengths: Input fields and action controls are properly interactive and accessible
Clear password reset and registration secondary buttons provided
reviews.reviewNotes: Sign-in form controls satisfy accessibility and focus expectations.

strengths: Sidebar navigation renders reliably with active state indicators and user profile details

issues.issue: Main viewport renders generic 'Loading your intelligence workspace...' message without skeleton components or default content
issues.evidence: Screenshot shows plain text 'Loading your intelligence workspace...' centered in an empty main content area

recommendations.recommendation: Implement skeleton loaders or pre-rendered dashboard overview cards to prevent screen flash and visual emptiness during load
recommendations.expectedImpact: Improves perceived performance and user orientation when navigating to the dashboard

reviews.reviewNotes: While navigation renders correctly, the main content area relies on a plain text spinner state.

strengths: Navigation bar accurately highlights 'Review Queue' as active route

issues.issue: Review queue route presents minimal 'Loading review queue...' loading text without layout structure
issues.evidence: Screenshot displays only 'Loading review queue...' in content area

recommendations.recommendation: Add a structured review queue skeleton layout with table/card outlines while fetching pending queue items
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduces layout shift and provides visual context on upcoming review tasks

reviews.reviewNotes: The route loads but relies on unstyled loading indicator text.

strengths: Rich, well-structured hub categorizing study operations, safety & compliance, and data quality workflows
Clear 'Recommended Starting Point' CTA banner guiding clinical coordinators into participant screening
Explicit TrialIQ assistance principle banner reinforcing human-in-the-loop workflow
reviews.reviewNotes: Clinical workspace route provides an excellent dashboard launchpad for clinical trial operations.

strengths: Route correctly resolves under `/dashboard/analytics` with navigation context intact

issues.issue: Analytics page displays basic 'Loading analytics...' plain text state
issues.evidence: Screenshot shows 'Loading analytics...' text in content panel

recommendations.recommendation: Introduce chart and KPI skeleton screens or initial empty states for analytics dashboards
recommendations.expectedImpact: Enhances visual consistency across dashboard routes

reviews.reviewNotes: Content panel relies on plain text loading feedback.

strengths: Navigation bar correctly tracks location at `/dashboard/reports`

issues.issue: Reports page displays 'Loading reports...' string rather than structured reports interface
issues.evidence: Screenshot shows 'Loading reports...' in the central view

recommendations.recommendation: Provide skeleton tables or template preview cards during reports data fetch
recommendations.expectedImpact: Delivers immediate feedback on available trial reporting structures

reviews.reviewNotes: Standardize loading UI elements across analytics and reporting views.

strengths: Clean settings form featuring account profile management, password change controls, and workspace access role badges
Intuitive password toggle visibility buttons and save controls
reviews.reviewNotes: Settings screen is fully functional and visually aligned with system aesthetics.

strengths: Informative transition state explaining that TrialIQ is connecting evidence across study modules
Clear header framing the evidence-to-decision methodology
reviews.reviewNotes: Transition state effectively communicates active background reasoning.

strengths: Comprehensive decision readiness breakdown with confidence and evidence completeness metrics
Clear severity badges (Critical, High, Moderate) and source citation pills for every finding
Deterministic protocol threshold checks cleanly distinguished from AI evidence interpretation
Actionable coordinator next steps grounded directly in underlying document evidence
reviews.reviewNotes: Outstanding review interface that bridges source data, protocol requirements, and human reviewer action items.

strengths: Explicit disclaimer footer clearly defining scope of AI output vs required human reviewer judgment
Model identification and metric transparency (finding confidence vs evidence completeness)
Thorough cross-document connections highlighting protocol deviations and adverse event timelines
reviews.reviewNotes: Excellent adherence to explainability and safety requirements in clinical research UI design.
